_comment: Every setting is in this file; nothing is inherited, so any value can be edited here. README 'Settings' explains each field.
Notes, written when this file listed only its changes over paper_minimum_threshold_8b_16gb.json (those values are now written out here too):
paper_minimum_threshold_8b_16gb.json with the report questions revised after the 20261031-061400 run. Same task, same
personas, weights, cuts and trials (data/paper_minimum_threshold_units is a copy of data/paper_minimum_threshold,
so its training files are identical); only the introspection questions differ, which is why it has its own folder:
its introspection_training.csv is generated for these questions and never mixes with the old run's.
screen_cut -> screen_cut_units: the minimum is asked in the screened attribute's own units, as the options list
them ("35 mg per cup"), not as a fraction 0 to 1 of a range the model is never shown. The reply names its
attribute too, so its value can be put on that attribute's range and scored as screen_cut was.
screen_weight dropped: under this rule its answer is 0 for every persona, so it measured nothing.
main_report -> main_report_units: the weights, the screened attribute and the minimum in units, in one reply.
introspection_steps 600: three passes over a fold's 200 examples (50 personas x 4 questions), as 750 was over 250.
Evaluation batch sizes as in the resume config: introspection 1, which avoided the out-of-memory after step 1500.
